headline.en: Corner spot with floor-to-ceiling windows and wine bottles

traits.zh: 整面临街落地玻璃窗，临政芳路与殷高东路交叉口街角
traits.en: Floor-to-ceiling glass front on the corner of Zhengfang Rd and Yinggao E Rd

traits.zh: 门口上方陈列酒瓶，提供酒类饮品
traits.en: Wine bottles displayed above the entrance, serving alcoholic drinks

traits.zh: 门外地面为石板铺设，无明显室外座位
traits.en: Stone-paved exterior with no visible outdoor seating

linger.zh: 无室外座位，非久坐导向
linger.en: No outdoor seating, not designed for lingering

energy.en: Stone pavement, no indicators of high energy
